_doc: Hero animation clips for Tripo text-to-motion / presets on the rigged proxy (job hero_body_front). label = SPEC §10 id. Prompts describe a 16 m heavy battle robot; keep the clips short and readable.
motions: dash_f
A giant heavy battle robot bursts forward with a sudden thruster dash, torso leaning far forward, arms swept back, then settles into a combat stance
dash_b
A giant heavy battle robot dashes backward in a sudden thruster burst, leaning back with knees bent, arms forward for balance, then settles into a combat stance
dash_l
A giant heavy battle robot dashes sideways to its left in a sudden burst, body tilted into the motion, legs together, then settles into a combat stance
dash_r
A giant heavy battle robot dashes sideways to its right in a sudden burst, body tilted into the motion, legs together, then settles into a combat stance
slide
A giant robot skates forward at high speed on its feet like ice skating, low wide stance, torso leaning forward, arms relaxed back, holding the pose
hover
A giant robot hovers in the air with legs slightly bent and dangling, arms out to the sides for balance, gently bobbing
fly
A giant robot flies forward like a superhero, body horizontal, legs straight back together, arms close to the body, holding the flying pose
melee_l1
A giant heavy battle robot performs a fast horizontal sword slash from right to left with its right hand, stepping forward with the left foot
melee_l2
A giant heavy battle robot performs a fast backhand horizontal sword slash from left to right with its right hand, stepping forward
melee_l3
A giant heavy battle robot performs a powerful spinning 360 degree sword slash with its right hand, finishing low in a wide stance
lunge
A giant heavy battle robot lunges forward with a long stabbing sword thrust of its right arm, body fully extended, then recovers
charge_slash
A giant heavy battle robot raises a sword high over its head with both hands, pauses gathering power, then smashes it straight down in a huge overhead strike
air_l1
A giant robot in mid air slashes a sword diagonally downward with its right hand while its legs tuck up
air_l2
A giant robot in mid air slashes a sword upward with its right hand in a rising arc while its legs swing down
return_cut
A giant heavy battle robot counterattacks instantly with a fast rising diagonal sword slash after blocking, stepping in
execution
A giant battle robot grabs an enemy in front with its left hand and drives a sword through it with its right hand, then pulls the sword out and steps back
guard_up
A giant robot raises its left forearm shield in front of its chest and braces in a low defensive stance, holding the guard
parry
A giant robot snaps its left forearm shield outward in a sharp quick deflection, knocking an attack aside
catch_hold
A giant robot extends its left palm forward with fingers spread as if holding an invisible force field, legs braced, holding the pose
catch_release
A giant robot thrusts both palms forward forcefully releasing an energy blast, leaning into it
fire_r
A giant robot fires a heavy rifle held in its right hand, the arm extended forward at shoulder height, absorbing the recoil
charge_r
A giant robot braces in a wide stance and aims a heavy rifle forward with both hands, holding steady while charging, then fires with strong recoil
reload
A giant robot pulls a rifle close to its chest and slams a new magazine into it with its left hand, then raises it again
missile_launch
A giant robot plants its feet, leans forward and hunches its shoulders as shoulder missile pods fire a salvo, absorbing the recoil
anchor_fire
A giant robot thrusts its left arm forward and upward firing a grappling cable, the body following the arm
rift_out
A giant robot crouches low and coils as if about to vanish in a teleport burst
rift_in
A giant robot appears from a crouch and rises sharply into an attack stance
fins_send
A giant robot spreads both arms wide and then points its right arm forward commanding a swarm of drones to attack
burst
A giant robot pulls its arms inward to its chest, crouches gathering energy, then throws its arms and chest outward releasing a huge shockwave
well_throw
A giant robot throws a heavy grenade overhand with its left arm, stepping forward
plunge_dive
A giant robot dives straight down from the air head first then flips to feet first with a sword raised above its head
plunge_land
A giant robot slams down onto the ground from a great height driving a sword into the ground, kneeling on one knee, then rises
overdrive_ignite
A giant robot clenches its fists and throws its arms and head back, powering up with great energy, then lowers into a fierce combat stance
lance_fire
A giant robot braces in a very wide stance holding a huge beam weapon forward with both hands, firing a continuous blast, slowly sweeping it from left to right
stagger
A giant robot is hit hard and staggers backward two steps, losing balance, then regains its stance
land_light
A giant robot lands on its feet from a short jump with a small knee bend and recovers to stand
ram_kick
A giant robot flies forward and delivers a powerful flying front kick with its right leg
death
A giant battle robot is destroyed: it shudders, drops to its knees and collapses face down onto the ground, motionless
